Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a report of pregnancy termination be provided to birth mother and biological father and kept by department of health.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting of pregnancy terminations; and addinga new section to chapter 9.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each hospital and facility where lawful induced abortions areperformed during the first, second, or third trimester of pregnancyshall, on forms prescribed and supplied by the secretary of health,report to the department of health during the following month thenumber and dates of induced abortions performed during the previousmonth, giving for each abortion the age of the patient, geographiclocation of patient's residence, patient's previous pregnancy history,the duration of the pregnancy, the method of abortion, anycomplications, such as perforations, infections, and incompleteevacuations, and the name of the physician or physicians performing orparticipating in the abortion. A copy of the report shall be deliveredto the birth mother and, if available at the time, the biological p. 1 SB 5836father. Reports must then be kept on file by the department of healthfor two biennia.
